reference: Bryg Mewa / sailertales/brig, original detailed PR 3 asset

furnishings: bunk frame, four legs and mattress
deck_equipment: standing/running rig blocks and rope supports

findings: Hold and cabin are actual enclosed interior views with ceiling, sole and furniture.
The hold hatch is a real visible void.
The cabin contains a bunk and a chart table.
Old renders are dim and deck framing lacks close inspection, so counts alone cannot establish a visual improvement.
visual_review.acceptance: Retain actual hollow spaces and access, add legible structural joinery and period appropriate fittings, retain frozen UV/material/topology/rig gates, and visually compare representative GLB views.

views.scope: Actual enclosed original hold, 1.23m camera height, 20mm lens and v5 auxiliary camera/target area fill.

views.name: cabin
views.scope: Actual enclosed original cabin, 1.23m camera height, 20mm lens and v5 auxiliary camera/target area fill.

inspection_findings: Main hatch is a real open shaft, physically framed by coamings; ladder rises through its void.
Deck closeup includes plank seams, cannon barrel/carriage/wheels and physical hatch edges.
Intact hold interior is a closed cavity with floor, ceiling, timber wall and water cask.
Intact cabin has a bunk and chart table; the belowdeck tiller is visible at the aft wall.
Neutral matched fill makes baseline grain and large simple surfaces visible; new detail must be assessed at the same physical field.
